result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Answer A keeps all trucks on screen in compact 36–40px rows across four lanes and checks that they fit at 1080p. It also limits emphasis to a single signal on the minutes figure that still works in grayscale. Answer B argues well against the hero stat and big cards, but its multi-line cards in five lanes could overflow a 1080p screen. B also stacks several exception signals (border, icon, label, bar), which makes it less compact and less quiet than A. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): B fits all trucks on screen with compact rows of about 36–40px in status lanes, sorted longest-first. It shows exceptions with a single strong signal on the minutes figure, and it explains why a hero stat or big cards would take space from the trucks. A's thin strip and in-place flags are good, but its multi-line cards may not fit 60 trucks without scrolling, it stacks several signals on each exception (border, icon, label, bar), and its 'fixed slot' idea conflicts with trucks moving between lanes.
